C1850.title: Cash-on-Delivery High-Value Order Rejection Followed by Logistics Impersonation to Steal Goods
keywords: Cash-on-Delivery High-Value Order Rejection Followed by Logistics Impersonation to Steal Goods
C1850.summary: In November 2024, CNR reported an online shopping platform cash-on-delivery fraud case. The offender impersonated a buyer, placed an order using cash-on-delivery, rejected the package after shipment, then used false return-logistics information to instruct a freight company to collect the package from an express station and transfer it elsewhere. The high-end electronics involved were worth more than 100,000 yuan, and the court pursued criminal liability for fraud.

references.title: High-value cash-on-delivery order rejected; merchants should beware of fraud - CNR
